primaryKeyword: practice management software for dental clinics
secondaryKeywords: dental practice management system, dental clinic scheduling software, patient billing software for dentists, dental insurance verification software
industryRegulations: HIPAA Privacy Rule and Security Rule, HITECH breach notification within 60 days, state dental board record-retention periods (commonly 7 years after last treatment, 7 years past age of majority for minors), CMS claim submission rules for state Medicaid dental programs, PCI DSS for card-present terminals at the front desk
industryJargon: chair-time utilization, operatory, no-show rate, recall and recare, hygiene column, treatment plan acceptance rate, insurance eligibility check, real-time benefits verification, claim rejection, EOB posting, production per operatory, unscheduled treatment, block scheduling
productDescription: Chairside is practice management software for independent and small-group dental clinics. Scheduling, patient recall, real-time insurance eligibility checks and patient billing all run off one patient record. It is used mainly by practices running 2 to 12 operatories, including multi-location groups that share a hygiene schedule across sites.

features.name: Real-time eligibility checks
features.description: Runs a live benefits check against the payer when the appointment is booked and again 48 hours before, and flags plan changes on the schedule.

features.name: Automated recall and recare
features.description: Tracks each patient's recare interval and sends reminders by SMS and email, with two-way replies that write straight back onto the schedule.

features.name: Waitlist auto-fill
features.description: When an appointment cancels, the open slot is offered to waitlisted patients by SMS in priority order until one accepts.

features.name: Treatment plan presentation
features.description: Builds a phased treatment plan with the patient's actual out-of-pocket cost after benefits, printable or sendable to the patient portal.

features.name: Claims and EOB posting
features.description: Submits claims electronically through the clearinghouse and auto-posts EOB payments against the ledger, queueing only the exceptions for review.

features.name: Per-record access logging
features.description: Logs every view and edit of a patient chart against the user and the reason, exportable as a HIPAA audit report.

integrations: Dentrix, Open Dental, Eaglesoft, DentalXChange, Stripe, Twilio, QuickBooks Online, Google Calendar
pricingModel: per operatory, from $149 per operatory per month with unlimited user seats, no per-claim fee
implementationTime: 14 days from signed contract to the first live appointment, including data migration and one training session
migrationNotes: Direct import from Dentrix and Open Dental backups, carrying completed treatment history, ledgers, recall status and imaging pointers. Eaglesoft requires an exported CSV. Historical claims older than 24 months are archived read-only rather than migrated.

frictionStrippers: no credit card required, and we never ask for live patient data to run the demo
ctaRules: Name Chairside explicitly in the closing CTA and tie it to the clinic's own schedule. Never promise a specific no-show reduction to a prospect, only report what named customers measured.
faqSeeds: How long does migration from Dentrix take?
Does it check insurance eligibility in real time?
How is it priced for a two-operatory practice?
Can it handle multiple locations on one hygiene schedule?
What happens to our old treatment history when we switch?
writingPreferences: Address the reader as "you" and assume they run or manage the practice. Say "clinic" rather than "office". Never use the word "solution" as a noun. Do not use the phrase "dental professionals".
